summary.narrative: Audited 6 resources across 4 sources; 4 findings accepted, 1 rejected, 1 left undetermined.

findings.claim: batch-01 averages 0.766% CPU with a peak of 0.888% across the requested window, and is declared in Terraform. Nothing in the evidence attributes a purpose to it.
findings.falsifier: a current, declared, owned purpose for this resource would withdraw this finding

history.reason: a schedule signal (month-end) is present, so the requested window may exclude the most recent run

findings.claim: sandbox-tmp is running and appears in no Terraform declaration. No owner tag attributes it to a team.

history.reason: no contradicting evidence found in the consulted sources

history.reason: no contradicting evidence found in the consulted sources

findings.claim: batch-01 averages 1.002% CPU but peaks at 58.0%. The cost is the idle shape it holds around the clock, not the work it does.
